families.name: sip_chaos_event
families.help: 1 at the instant an incident reached a phase (incident, phase, source, run); the shell chaos lane pushes its events under type and result.

families.name: sip_chaos_window
families.help: 1 while an incident window is open, 0 when it closes (incident, run); the shell chaos lane pushes its windows under type.

families.name: sip_chaos_window_verdict
families.help: A window's verdict when the run's verdict is written: 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 invalid (its incident failed).

families.name: sip_chaos_window_findings
families.help: A window's impacts above their allowance, when the run's verdict is written.

families.name: sip_chaos_run_verdict
families.help: A run's verdict when it is written: 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 invalid.

families.name: sip_soak_up
families.help: 1 while a workflow supervising a run reports its state.

families.name: sip_soak_phase
families.help: The supervising workflow's phase: 1 on the current phase, 0 on every other.

families.name: sip_soak_events_seen
families.help: Incident events the supervising workflow has seen so far.

families.name: sip_soak_events_expected
families.help: Incident events the supervising workflow expects in the run.

families.name: sip_soak_finding
families.help: 1 per finding the supervising workflow escalated, by its signature and severity.

families.name: sipp_records_total
families.help: Call-outcome records the SIPp UAC wrote, by ending.

families.name: sipp_records_shipped_total
families.help: Call-outcome records posted to the log store.

families.name: sipp_records_ship_failures_total
families.help: Posts of call-outcome records that failed; the records stay queued.

families.name: sipp_records_pending
families.help: Call-outcome records read and not yet posted.
